m: 1. तस् cl. 4. ˚स्यति, to fade away, perish, Dhātup. xxvi, 103; (cf. √ तंस्) to cast upwards (or ‘to throw down’), ib. (Vop.); to throw, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 61, Kāś.

a: तस् — {c4c} P. (तस्यति) 1 To fade away, become exhausted. --2 To throw down. --3 To wane, decay, perish. --4 To reject, cast. [cf. Eng. toss.]
